Synthetic static-only fixtures; do not execute.

The character subtraction moves from C2 staging to data/decode/charset,
with notable criticality: Chr(variable-variable) alone establishes neither
obfuscation nor payload staging. The integer array moves to data/collection/
array and now requires Array syntax and 20 entries. Arithmetic obfuscation
requires both observations. The old generic hidden-launch conviction is
replaced with payload API evidence and separately observed concealment.
No exact or ancestor directory YAML consumers select the removed three IDs.
The sibling MSXML reconstruction rule and its hex accumulator are unchanged.

The new five-digit compact-table matcher compares each decoded API character
relative to its first character. It requires all four API tokens in one valid
comma-separated array and is independent of key, helper names and endpoints.
It does not prove data flow; descriptions report encoded API co-occurrence.
Whitespace/variable-width integer encodings and tables over 32KB are outside
its representation. The API-table test-rules inline-YARA trace can report a miss
while runtime findings report a match; inspect the findings as well.

Run style zero preserves small VBScript statement calls and adds long quoted
command calls using a positive command-character class. Positive controls cover 7KB
arguments, three offset keys and all three valid eval split points. Near
misses cover an unrelated zero argument, absent download API, a visible launch,
ordinary automation and the e+l false positive within WScript.Shell.

Scan copies of these fixtures outside testdata when checking the eval-name
trait: its pre-existing test-directory exclusion intentionally suppresses
matches on repository fixture paths. Match reports back to cases by basename.
